lines.zh: 沙虫贴着荒地慢慢蠕动
lines.en: The worm inches over the waste, close to the ground.
Its body humps and stretches.

lines.zh: 沙土被它拖出一条细沟
lines.en: It drags a thin furrow in the dirt.
It moves slowly but never turns aside.
It pushes forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 它的小身体贴着土疙瘩爬
lines.en: It crawls against clods of earth.
It passes under a stone.
Its movement is almost invisible.
Its front end pulls in and reaches out.

lines.zh: 它沿着一条干裂的缝爬
lines.en: It follows a cracked seam in the ground.

lines.zh: 它的影子比它自己大得多
lines.en: Its shadow is far bigger than it is.
It pauses, then worms on.
The worm curls at the edge of dry grass.
It draws itself into a short length.
One end lifts slightly.
It looks asleep.

lines.zh: 干土落在它身上，它不动
lines.en: Dry soil settles on it; it does not stir.
Its body twitches now and then.

lines.zh: 它把自己埋进半个身子
lines.en: It buries half of itself.
It looks like a short grey cord.
The wind passes; it presses closer to the grass.
Its colour matches the wasteland.
The worm lifts its front end at you.
It cannot tell what you are.
It draws itself in a little.
It is unsure whether to come closer.
It moves slowly toward your boot.

lines.zh: 它在你的影子边上停住
lines.en: It stops at the edge of your shadow.
It has no eyes, only feeling.
It touches your shoe lightly.
Then it pulls back a little.
And it comes at you again.
The worm snaps into a ball.
It bounces twice on the ground.
One end twitches.
It digs half of itself under.

lines.zh: 它从土里探出一点看看
lines.en: It peeks back out a little.
It stretches itself thin.
It turns a circle in place.
It crawls slowly away.
It cannot help turning back.
Its movement is slower now.
The worm shifts toward the smell.
It stops before the food, still.
It lays its front end on it.
It starts drawing it in.
Halfway through it pauses.
Then carries on.
It coils around what is left.
Done, it draws slowly away.
It comes back for more.
It curls in a ring by your feet.
The worm bounces at the touch.
It curls into a small ball.
It slowly uncurls and tries to move.
It rolls half a turn by your shoe.
It crawls away along the ground.
The push shifts it half a foot.
It does not fight, only hides.
It slips into a crack in the soil.
Then pokes out again.
It shakes the grains of soil off.
Two worms twine together.

lines.zh: 它们绕成一个小小的结
lines.en: They knot into a small loop.

lines.zh: 它们一伸一缩，节奏一致
lines.en: They stretch and contract in time.
They press against the base of dry grass.

lines.zh: 它们几乎看不出是两条
lines.en: They barely look like two.

lines.zh: 它们把身体埋进土里一半
lines.en: They bury half their length.
They stay still a long while.
When wind passes, both draw in.
Their colour merges.

lines.zh: 荒地上看不出这里有什么
lines.en: You would not guess anything was there.
The worm coils around the food.

lines.zh: 它一点点把东西裹进来
lines.en: It wraps the item in by degrees.
It presses the food under itself.

lines.zh: 它吸食时身体一起一伏
lines.en: Its body rises and falls as it feeds.

lines.zh: 它把不合口的东西推开
lines.en: What it dislikes, it pushes away.
It drags the food into a crack.
Done, it shrinks into a ball.

lines.zh: 它从土里拱出来找剩下的
lines.en: It surfaces to look for leftovers.

lines.zh: 它绕着你给的东西转圈
lines.en: It circles what you offer.
It crawls back deep into the waste.
The worm turns toward you.
It lifts its front end high.
Its body pulls taut.
It comes slowly at your feet.

lines.zh: 它把身体拉长，像根鞭子
lines.en: It stretches out like a whip.

lines.zh: 它的动作忽然快了一点
lines.en: Its motion quickens slightly.
It coils toward your shoe.
It seems incapable of fear.
It winds upward by degrees.
It has reached your leg.
It starts cinching loop by loop.

lines.zh: 它的前端顶住你的裤腿
lines.en: Its front end presses your trouser leg.
It pulls its whole length straight.
It starts working under your sole.

lines.zh: 它在你脚边盘成一个环
lines.en: It loops into a ring at your feet.

lines.zh: 它显得比刚才更有精神
lines.en: It seems livelier than before.
The worm coils around your ankle.
It winds higher, loop by loop.
It pulls tight and dead.

lines.zh: 它贴在你的皮肤上，很凉
lines.en: It lies cold against your skin.
It tries another loop.
You shake it; it does not let go.
It works slowly toward your knee.
Its body pulses.
It seems to listen to your bones.
It keeps biting into the flesh.
Being dragged along does not trouble it.
It simply will not let go.

lines.zh: 它顺着你的鞋带往上爬
lines.en: It climbs along your laces.
It goes twice around your ankle.
It pauses on your leg.

lines.zh: 它好像在找最细的地方
lines.en: It seems to seek the narrowest point.
You step; it gets dragged along.
A bit of it shows at your trouser hem.
Then it creeps back in.
Its strength is small, its stubbornness isn't.

lines.zh: 沙虫缠住你的脚踝收力
lines.en: The worm cinches your ankle.
It squeezes until you stagger.
Its front end butts you.
It winds up your calf.
It pulls like a rope.

lines.zh: 它在你皮肤上留下一道红
lines.en: It leaves a red line on your skin.
Shaken off, it coils back on.
It crawls over your shoe.
It bites, a tiny nip.
It eases off and presses in again.
There is little strength in it.
It merely refuses to leave you.

lines.zh: 它在你小腿上收紧一圈
lines.en: It cinches a loop on your calf.
It slaps your instep with its body.

lines.zh: 它把自己拉成一条直线
lines.en: It pulls itself into a straight line.
It braces against your heel.
Stepped on, it jerks hard.
It winds from heel to toe.
It leaves a shallow band.
It slackens, then tightens again.

lines.zh: 干土里冒出一小段身子
lines.en: A short length of body pushes up from the soil.
The worm comes out of the earth.
It shakes the sand off.
It moves toward the disturbance.
It stops at the edge of the dry grass.

lines.zh: 它的身体颜色和土一样
lines.en: Its colour matches the dirt.
It stretches out to feel about.
A small furrow stays behind it.

lines.zh: 它的动作慢得像在睡觉
lines.en: Its movement is slow as sleep.
It begins crawling your way.
Its head surfaces first.

lines.zh: 随后整条身子才钻出来
lines.en: Then the rest of its body follows.
The heat makes it snap inward.
It lands and sprawls out flat.
In the water its writhing slows.
The blast throws it far.
An arrow pins it to the dirt.
Odd force runs through it in sharp jerks.

lines.zh: 瘦成一条线，它几乎不动
lines.en: Starved to a thread, it barely moves.
Lightning curls it up hard.

lines.zh: 虚空吸它，它拼命往土里钻
lines.en: The void pulls; it drills into the dirt.
